paragraphs.text: The Elder Druid is the leading druid of the Juniper Order on Dominaria . The druidic order of Havenwood also had an Elder Druid before its fall.
Known druids include Kolbjorn , his daughter Kaysa , her daughter Jasha Carthalion , and her descendant Jenson Carthalion .
Other orders also had Elder Druids, e.g. the nameless Elder Druid of Corondor and Kolevi of Havenwood.

The Mark of the Elder Druid is a crescent moon mark found on a select few individuals on Dominaria . These people have included many of the Carthalion lineage — though the Mark is not strictly hereditary — as well as the druids of the Juniper Order. Only one or two people at a time bear the Mark. The birth of a new person with the Mark is referred to as "the turning of the wheel".
Known characters with the Mark include Carth , Kaysa , Jared Carthalion , and Jenson Carthalion .
